items.title: Stocks have their worst day since April 2025; "Nasdaqistan" memes
items.summary: An AI-led sell-off sent the Nasdaq down 5.5% into correction, the S&P 500 down 4.4% and the Dow down 1,833 points, the worst day for all three since the April 2025 tariff shock; Nvidia fell more than 9% and AMD about 17%. Bryan Johnson posted himself bathing in the glow of a red stock heatmap as red-light therapy, "always improving my protocol" (28K likes), Zero Hedge priced the wipeout at "almost 3 Elons," and finance X filed dispatches from "Nasdaqistan" ("JUST IN: explosions heard in the city center of Nasdaqistan"). The same day in London, Russell Brand was found guilty of one count of rape and three of sexual assault.
items.author: @bryan_johnson
